response.sql: WITH major_counts AS (SELECT j.major_id, j.department, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM member AS m JOIN major AS j ON m.link_to_major = j.major_id GROUP BY j.major_id, j.department), major_shares AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, 1.0 * member_count / SUM(member_count) OVER () AS share FROM major_counts), compared AS (SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER (PARTITION BY department) AS difference_above_department_average FROM major_shares) SELECT major_id, department, member_count, share, difference_above_department_average FROM compared WHERE difference_above_department_average > 0 ORDER BY difference_above_department_average DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10;
